title: Non-blocking follow-up from frontend-trade-journal-followup-review PR #248 review
description: Non-blocking finding from pr-reviewer's full review of PR #248 (frontend-trade-journal-followup-review), recorded here per CLAUDE.md's convention so it isn't lost once the PR merges. Everything else in that review passed cleanly: static analysis (ruff/mypy/eslint/tsc/profit-target-wording), backend+frontend coverage (backend 99.95%, frontend statements 99.73%/branches 99.21%/functions 99.74%/lines 99.79%, all new files 100%), the persisted e2e suite (18/18 passing), and a live headless-Chromium walkthrough (due-list render, Record Review -> fill notes -> Save -> dialog closes immediately -> trade drops off the due list and stays gone after reload, plus a blank/whitespace-only-notes validation edge case blocking submission with no network call) -- this is a coverage gap to close, not a defect that blocks the accept.

checklist.step: No Playwright e2e spec (frontend/tests/e2e/*.spec.ts) exercises the new 'Due for Follow-Up Review' panel or FollowUpReviewDialog end to end -- portfolio.spec.ts wasn't extended, and no new spec file was added, even though the flow adds a new API round trip (POST .../follow-up-review) and a new query-string filter (due_for_follow_up=true) that the existing e2e suite's fixture-provider backend now serves live. Per the e2e-test skill's own 'Relationship to Other Checks' note ('If a new UI flow is added, the underlying task should also add or extend an e2e spec for it'), this flow should get a persisted regression spec (e.g. extend portfolio.spec.ts: seed a due trade via the running backend's fixture-provider database, record a review through the UI, assert it drops off the due list) rather than relying solely on mocked component tests plus one-off manual browser walkthroughs for future regression coverage.
